reference.title: Image Rasters
reference.shortdesc: A type of digital image that allows for photorealistic details, but loses quality when scaled.

refbody.section: Image rasters are digital images composed of a grid of pixels. As raster graphics are scaled up, quality decreases because they are dependent on resolution. Sizing the image up or down will impact image quality.
Raster image files are generally larger in size than vector graphic files.
